Hat shadow too heavy under top light

poses.name: Arm-Extended Selfie
poses.description: One arm fully extended forward at shoulder height, elbow locked. Torso twisted forty-five degrees; free hand on the hip or at the hair. Legs staggered with rear leg straight and front knee bent.
steps: Take a selfie with one arm extended
Let the other hand drop naturally or touch your hair
Hold the phone slightly above eye level
common_mistakes: Phone too low, creating a double chin
Arm bent, shortening the selfie angle
Background too close, making the face appear larger

poses.name: Legs Together on Tiptoe
poses.description: Heels raised on the balls of the feet, ankles aligned. Legs together; spine stretched vertically. Arms at the sides or lifted overhead; pelvis tucked slightly; head high over the cervical stack.
steps: Keep legs together and rise onto tiptoe
Keep hands natural or slightly raised
Engage the core and tuck the abdomen slightly
common_mistakes: Pose makes the body appear shorter

poses.name: Head-Back Laugh
poses.description: Head thrown back with throat open; upper back arched lightly. Torso folded a few degrees at the waist. One hand on the abdomen or in the hair; opposite arm loose. Knees soft; weight centered.
steps: Laugh naturally with the head tipped back
Place one hand on the stomach or in the hair
Keep the expression real, not acted
common_mistakes: Eyes closed too much while laughing

poses.name: One Foot Raised on Wall
poses.description: One foot raised with bent knee, sole near a vertical plane beside the body. Three-quarter stance; same-side hand pressed to that plane at shoulder height or lifted to the hair. Standing leg straight; hips stacked over the supporting ankle.
steps: Raise one foot against the wall
Place one hand on the wall or in the hair
Relax the raised leg and keep the support leg stable
common_mistakes: Raised leg too low, weakening the pose
Wall color blending into the clothing

poses.name: Shoulder to Shoulder, Eyes on Camera
poses.description: Three people standing in a row, shoulders lightly touching, torsos angled forty-five degrees toward the lens. People on the ends keep one arm down and the other across the middle person's upper back. Heads upright and necks relaxed; feet parallel and hip-width apart.
steps: Two or three in a row
Outer hands down or on neighbor's back

poses.name: Staggered Front-Back Layers
poses.description: Two people in staggered depth: one forward in three-quarter view, one behind offset to the side. The front person turns their torso; rear partner's head peeking over the shoulder line. Feet on different planes; arms relaxed.
steps: Stagger front and back for depth
Front person angled toward the camera
Rear person peeks over the shoulder or turns to show their face
Eyes on camera or each other

poses.name: Face Each Other Laughing
poses.description: Two people facing each other half a step apart, heads inclined inward without contact. Hands on each other's upper arms or shoulders. Weight on both feet; spines vertical.
steps: Face each other half a step apart
Hand lightly on arm or shoulder
common_mistakes: Looking at camera instead of each other

poses.name: Mixed Sit-Stand Heights
poses.description: Two people in height contrast: one seated on a step, torso twisted toward the viewer; one standing behind and beside, torso leaning forward. Heads at different elevations; knees bent on the seated person.

poses.name: Casual Back-to-Back
poses.description: Two people back to back, shoulder blades touching, spines straight. Heads rotated toward the viewer or opposite directions. Arms at sides or hands in pockets at the hip line.
steps: Face camera or look different ways
Hands in pockets or at sides

poses.name: Semicircle Formation
poses.description: Four people arranged in a semicircle opening toward the viewer, bodies angled inward. Heads turned to the center or forward; feet spaced evenly on the arc; arms at sides or on neighbors' backs.
steps: Three to five in a semicircle
Look at camera or center person

poses.name: Walking Candid Group
poses.description: Four people walking abreast or in a loose line, legs in varied stride phases. Arms swinging naturally; some heads forward, some turned to a neighbor. Shoulders level with the path.
steps: Walk side by side or front-back
Look at camera or each other

poses.name: One Lead, Others Supporting
poses.description: Four people with one centered forward, posture more open. People on the sides set back and angled toward the center, heads turned to the focal person. Feet form a shallow V.
steps: Others angled or looking at lead

poses.name: Arm Over Shoulder Bond
poses.description: Three people clustered with arms draped over shoulders or upper backs. Torsos leaned inward; heads close at the same height; weight on the inner feet.
steps: Hand on neighbor's shoulder or back
Look at camera or each other

poses.name: Tiered Stagger Stand
poses.description: Four people on staggered elevations, lowest in front, tallest in rear. Each body three-quarter turned; heads aligned on one horizon line; feet on separate treads.
steps: Each person slightly angled to camera

poses.name: Gesture Interaction
poses.description: Four people in a tight cluster with hands meeting overhead for a slap or forming shapes toward the center. Bodies bent toward the gesture; elbows high.

poses.name: Center Focus Group
poses.description: Four people with one seated or standing at the hub; others ring the center facing inward. Outer heads toward the middle or toward the viewer; knees bent on the seated hub.
steps: One seated or standing at center
Arrange the others around the center, in front or behind

poses.name: Shared Forward Gaze
poses.description: Four people in a line sharing the same gaze direction, bodies three-quarter to the viewer. Heads turned together off-frame; arms at sides; feet forward.
common_mistakes: Someone looking at the camera breaks the mood

poses.name: Casual Mixed Seating
poses.description: Four people seated on the ground or low furniture in varied poses: cross-legged, legs to one side, one knee up. Torso angles differ; some heads toward the viewer, some toward a neighbor.
steps: Group seated on floor or sofa
Look at camera or each other

poses.name: Triangle Composition
poses.description: Three people in triangular placement: one person at the forward apex, two behind spaced wide. All bodies slightly rotated; feet shoulder-width; heads aligned on one plane facing forward.
steps: One slightly forward, two behind spaced apart

poses.name: Foreground-Background Depth
poses.description: Four people with one large in the foreground, torso three-quarter, shoulder nearest the lens. Additional figures smaller in the rear plane, standing naturally; depth between the rows.
steps: One close to lens as foreground
Use aperture for depth of field
common_mistakes: Shallow depth of field blurs rear

poses.name: Casual Chat Moment
poses.description: Four people in a loose ring or line, bodies oriented toward each other. Mixed head directions; hands mid-gesture at chest height; weight shifted on one hip per person.
steps: Form a loose ring or line
Mix gazes between the camera and friends
common_mistakes: Everyone staring at camera looks fake

poses.name: Pockets In, Cool Group Look
poses.description: Four people standing apart or in a row, some with thumbs hooked at the hip line. Torsos angled; chins raised; legs straight or one knee bent.
steps: Chin slightly up or eyes on camera

poses.name: Arc Formation
poses.description: Four people along a curved arc facing the concave side, shoulders turned inward. Spacing even on the curve; heads toward the center point; feet tangent to the arc.

poses.name: Group Jump Energy
poses.description: Four people simultaneously airborne in a low jump, knees bent, arms raised or out. Bodies stretched upward; feet tucked or split; heads aligned with the spine on the ascent.
steps: Do a small group jump together
Or raise hands or feet for energy
